# accumulator.ensure_not_processed { #healpyxel.accumulator.ensure_not_processed }

```python
accumulator.ensure_not_processed(meta, input_path, *, on_duplicate='error')
```

Check/add input fingerprint in state metadata for idempotency.

Computes a SHA-256 fingerprint from the input file's path, size, and
mtime. If the fingerprint is already in the ``processed_inputs`` list,
either raises an error or records the skip, depending on ``on_duplicate``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type        | Description                                                                                                         | Default    |
|--------------|-------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| meta         | dict        | State metadata dict (modified in-place).                                                                            | _required_ |
| input_path   | str or Path | Path to input data file.                                                                                            | _required_ |
| on_duplicate | str         | ``'error'`` — raise ``ValueError`` if already processed. ``'skip'`` — record in ``skipped_duplicate`` and continue. | `'error'`  |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                               |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | dict   | Updated metadata dict with new fingerprint added to ``processed_inputs``. |
